note: The automation-change trail. Every machine upgrade a run makes to itself lands here, with the evidence that earned it and how it was verified. Surfaced in the delivery summary so a change to the machine is never invisible. An upgrade with no evidence line is not an upgrade, it is a preference, and it does not belong here.
guard: A run may NEVER edit knowledge/OUTREACH_CRAFT.md, CLAUDE.md, or any quality bar it is judged against. Those are hand-authored on purpose, because a routine that rewrites the rules it is graded by is grading its own homework. A run PROPOSES those in the delivery summary and a human decides.

upgrades.change: scripts/study_lint.py, a mechanical gate that runs before any critic sees the study
upgrades.evidence: The study-critic returned twelve blocking items and at least five were mechanical: an unsourced claim, a verified mark on an absence, two unverifiable negatives about the prospect, and an ROI note whose arithmetic did not reconcile with its own table. Five expensive adversarial rounds spent on things a regex and some arithmetic catch in milliseconds.
upgrades.verified_how: Ran against the shipped study, clean with zero false positives. Then ran against five reconstructions of the actual defects that shipped or were blocked today, and it caught all five.

upgrades.change: study_qa splits prose words from structure words
upgrades.evidence: A study whose prose spine is 2,947 words reported 3,858 because table cells, source lines and figure labels were counted against a reading-time budget that only ever meant prose. Three trimming passes fought a number that did not mean what it said, while the critics were simultaneously demanding more disclosure.
upgrades.verified_how: The shipped study passes the prose gate at 2,947 with every honesty disclosure intact, 18/18.

upgrades.evidence: Seventeen leads, one confirmed send, zero recorded outcomes. Every quality gate in this routine is tuned against a target nobody has measured, which makes the anti-hype thesis an article of faith.
upgrades.verified_how: Scoreboard runs and reports honestly that nothing is recorded yet, rather than implying a result it does not have.
